headline: Pauline Clayden, Dancer in a Seminal 1949 ‘Sleeping Beauty,’ Dies at 103
context: She was the last known surviving soloist from an event that changed American dance: the opening night of Sadler’s Wells Ballet’s first U.S. tour.

sources.name: The New York Times
